additional_context: Predict the surface activity from the supplied examples. Every candidate is a peptide amphiphile with an N-terminal C16 tail and a tripeptide headgroup. Measurements at pH 3 use citrate buffer, measurements at pH 7 use phosphate buffer, and measurements at pH 11 use Tris buffer. A peptide is considered surface active if it has a surface tension value below 50 mN/m.
decision_question: Is the peptide C{tail_length}-{sequence} surface active at pH {pH}?
